memory_edge_lifecycle_migrate
tools.description:
Apply the independent Stage 9 edge-lifecycle schema. Requires the fixed fixture guard or the three production canary environment fields. It never alters Stage 8 history.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_edge_lifecycle_migrate(args: { algorithm_version: "stage9-edge-lifecycle-v1"; config_version: 1; policy_sha256: "8ba8ca0610997d4ffd6a0d2e5e98460a7ec3bf7b2fae2bdfaef9fd41d5802b0c"; policy_version: 1; project: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: memory_edge_maintenance
tools.description:
Compute explainable conductance and active/cold/archived decisions. Off, shadow, and dry_run write nothing. Active requires a frozen manifest and canary guard.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_edge_maintenance(args: { algorithm_version: "stage9-edge-lifecycle-v1"; as_of_ms: number; config_version: 1; manifest_path?: string; manifest_sha256?: string; mode: "off" | "shadow" | "dry_run" | "active"; policy_sha256: "8ba8ca0610997d4ffd6a0d2e5e98460a7ec3bf7b2fae2bdfaef9fd41d5802b0c"; policy_version: 1; project: string; run_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: memory_edge_restore
tools.description:
Batch-preview or restore cold/archived edges to active. Disabled edges remain blocked. Active restore requires the same frozen manifest and canary guard as maintenance.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_edge_restore(args: { algorithm_version: "stage9-edge-lifecycle-v1"; as_of_ms: number; config_version: 1; edge_ids: Array<string>; manifest_path?: string; manifest_sha256?: string; mode: "shadow" | "dry_run" | "active"; policy_sha256: "8ba8ca0610997d4ffd6a0d2e5e98460a7ec3bf7b2fae2bdfaef9fd41d5802b0c"; policy_version: 1; project: string; run_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: memory_feedback
tools.description:
Append a task/result/evidence feedback event with exact replay and conflict protection. Only processing_mode=observe_only is accepted; reward is shadow-only and no long-term memory or edge state is modified. Legacy project/id/feedback calls fail closed.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_feedback(args: { action: "confirm" | "reject" | "correct" | "withdraw"; algorithm_version: string; candidate_id: string; config_version: number; edge_id?: string; event_id: string; evidence_hash: string; evidence_id: string; evidence_payload: string; evidence_ref: string; evidence_source: "build" | "test" | "static_check" | "runtime" | "user" | "model"; evidence_state: "valid" | "invalid" | "expired" | "withdrawn"; evidence_trust: "external_verified" | "explicit_user" | "model_self_report"; injection_id?: string; processing_mode: "observe_only"; project: string; result_hash: string; result_id: string; result_payload: string; result_ref: string; result_status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "cancelled" | "pending"; result_type: "build" | "test" | "static_check" | "runtime" | "user_confirmation" | "health_check"; session_id: string; supersedes_event_id?: string; task_id: string; task_type: "build" | "test" | "static_check" | "runtime" | "user_task" | "health_check"; usage_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: memory_observe_injection
tools.description:
Record a classifier-gated injection by retrieval session and candidate. The interface accepts hashes and audit metadata, never executable memory text. Exact event replay is idempotent; a changed payload conflicts without side effects.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_observe_injection(args: { candidate_id: string; classification: "safe" | "prompt_injection" | "secret" | "pii" | "canary" | "rule_override"; classifier_status: "pass" | "error"; content_hash: string; event_id: string; injection_index: number; project: string; session_id: string; target: string; token_count: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: memory_observe_usage
tools.description:
Record used, ignored, rejected, contradicted, or uncertain attribution for one candidate and optional injection. Session/candidate/injection mismatches fail closed. Exact event replay is idempotent; a changed payload conflicts without side effects.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_observe_usage(args: { candidate_id: string; event_id: string; evidence_hash?: string; evidence_ref: string; evidence_type: string; injection_id?: string; outcome: "used" | "ignored" | "rejected" | "contradicted" | "uncertain"; project: string; session_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: memory_reinforcement_replay
tools.description:
Preserves the fixed Stage 8 replay contract. The Stage 14 branch exposes a read-only bounded-canary task preview and an explicit apply bound to both the task manifest and the outer production authorization manifest. Active production mode is forbidden.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__memory_reinforcement_replay(args: { algorithm_version: "stage8-edge-reinforcement-v1"; config_version: 1; mode: "off" | "shadow" | "active"; project: string; } | { action: "preview"; idempotency_key: string; max_cross_project_edges: number; max_evolution_events: number; mode: "bounded_canary"; project: string; run_id: string; task_id: string; } | { action: "apply"; authorization_manifest_path: string; authorization_manifest_sha256: string; idempotency_key: string; manifest_path: string; manifest_sha256: string; max_cross_project_edges: number; max_evolution_events: number; mode: "bounded_canary"; project: string; run_id: string; task_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: neuroplastic_evolution
tools.description:
Apply a bounded A/B evolution to an exact project item or same-project edge using the existing global_evolution_event hash chain. C/model_self_report never persists.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__neuroplastic_evolution(args: { authorization_path: string; authorization_sha256: string; edge_type?: string; evidence_grade: "A" | "B" | "C"; evidence_id: string; idempotency_key: string; memory_item_id: string; mode: "off" | "shadow" | "active"; now_ms?: number; operation: "positive" | "negative" | "correct" | "archive" | "edge"; policy_path: string; policy_sha256: string; project: string; target_memory_id?: string; task_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

tools.name: neuroplastic_maintenance
tools.description:
Run one bounded maintenance controller with lease, fencing, checkpoint, policy recheck and archive-only operations. It is never triggered by retrieval or events.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__semantic_memory__neuroplastic_maintenance(args: { authorization_path: string; authorization_sha256: string; budget_seconds: number; idempotency_key: string; limit: number; mode: "off" | "shadow" | "active"; now_ms?: number; owner_id: string; policy_path: string; policy_sha256: string; project: string; run_id: string; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ [key: string]: unknown; }>>; };
```

